concept: Branding for a business that doesn't exist. One roll of woven labels for a made-up knitwear maker (Thrumwick), rendered in 3D (Blender) on sand linen and shot three ways: folded into eight rows, navy with the name in ivory on the front and the other way round on the back; right up against two rows, where the letters step thread by thread; then the roll itself with its cut tail drawn out. Thrumwick doesn't exist. We branded it anyway. Your business does. Sand, navy and ivory.
